title: Use Alexa+ to schedule meetings and hear your calendar read aloud by voice
facebook: Hands-free calendar management? Yes please. Once you link your calendar to Alexa, you can ask "What's on my calendar today?" and hear your whole day read aloud — perfect when your hands are full. https://aiworldhq.com/article/use-alexa-to-schedule-meetings-and-hear-your-calendar-read-aloud-by-vo #productivity #voiceassistant
